title: WBAP — Dallas RNC protest post-booking charge report
summary: WBAP reports, citing Dallas County jail records, that the two people booked after the September 10 convention protest carried distinct three-charge sets: one booking had two counts of assault causing bodily injury plus one count of obstructing a highway or passageway; the other had one count of assault causing bodily injury, one count of interference with public duties, and one count of obstructing a highway or passageway. WBAP reports each charge carried a $5,000 bond, for $15,000 total per person. These remain accusations, not adjudicated findings.
